Hi Aditya,

Quick note — our execs just moved a prep meeting into the slot for tomorrow's console walkthrough (Aug 31 11:00 AM PT). We still want the session but need to move it. We have a group of ~6 engineers + 2 product folks who want hands-on API access and a console demo. Recording would be appreciated and we need a short checklist for prod-like creds ahead of the session.

Can we look at the following (in PT):
- Tue Sep 2, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 3, 16:00–17:00
- Thu Sep 4, 09:00–10:00

Thanks,

ClearPath Systems
